text: もし　とくべつな　どうぐが…　シルフスコープさえ　あれば　みやぶれるかも　しれないが…

structure.jp: もし　とくべつな　どうぐが…
シルフスコープさえ　あれば
structure.en: if only we had a Silph Scope

structure.jp: みやぶれるかも　しれないが…
structure.en: we might be able to see through them, but…

patterns.name: 〜さえ〜ば
patterns.span: シルフスコープさえ　あれば
patterns.explanation: さえ with a ば 'if' form means 'if only this one thing' were so, that would be enough. シルフスコープさえ あれば = 'if only we had a Silph Scope'.

patterns.name: 〜かもしれない
patterns.span: みやぶれるかも　しれない
patterns.explanation: かもしれない after a verb says it may be so but you are not sure. みやぶれるかも しれない = 'we might be able to see through them'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing the last sound of the verb to an え sound plus る means 'can do'. みやぶれる = 'can see through'.
